assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original premium 3D editorial illustration for Testmedaddy, an independent platform for community-funded peptide batch lab testing. Visual language: precise scientific glass, satin ivory ceramic, translucent lilac acrylic, brushed silver, soft violet shadows, restrained indigo accents. Palette #f4f2fb, #ece9fb, #b6adf0, #5b4fd1, #2a2359. Soft studio lighting, convincing material detail, elegant and reassuring, uncluttered. This is conceptual marketing art, not a real lab record. No words, letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks, readable reports, medical treatment, syringes, flowers, foliage, temples or landscapes. Asset type: wide website hero illustration, landscape 3:2 aspect ratio. Scene: three clear sealed small laboratory sample vials with silver crimp caps and subtle white powder at the bottom, precisely arranged on a low circular frosted lavender sample platform. One larger vial is central, smaller vials flank it, connected visually by a delicate translucent circular ring with several small round contribution tokens resting along it, representing a community funding one test. A slender translucent glass molecular ball-and-stick sculpture sits behind the vials to one side. Center the whole arrangement in the lower 65 percent of the image, all principal objects within the central 65 percent of width for mobile cropping. Upper 35 percent is uninterrupted very pale lavender negative space blending to #ecebfa at the top. Camera slightly above eye level, lens 70mm, grounded objects and soft contact shadows. Detailed photorealistic CGI, composition wide and calm, no cropped vial tops.
